script.text: With Yuya's victory, the You Show team was one victory away from keeping their school.
You're up next, Zuzu. We're counting on you.
Don't worry. Just leave it to me. I know our whole school is at stake, so I know I have to win this!
That boy's Pendulum Cards will be mine one way or another! Begin the second duel!
Yes, Madame Chairwoman. My name is Julia Crystal and I'm a Fusion Summoner!
Your father may see you as a sparkling little jewel, but we know better don't we?
You're a fake, a liar—too afraid to tell the truth about what your pal did!
You don't know anything about me!
Maybe not, but I know a lot about jewels. I know how real jewels shine. And you don't have that shine.
You can believe whatever you want to believe!
